title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have named my daughter as Mehwish, I wanted to know if its islamically premitted or not? 4081 views Q. My wife is expecting. She would be delivering in a few days. I have heard that if a person makes niyat that he would name the newborn as Muhammad, then he would be gifted with a son. I had decided in my mind that Insha Allah I would name my first born "Muhammad Imdadullah", with due to respect to the prophet SAS and love for the saint Haji Imdadullah Makki (RAH). But on consulting an aalim, he has said that the name is a mismatch. I'm in a predicament, whether I can add Haji sahab's name to the name Muhammad or not? Please guide me. 2802 views Q. Islamic Arabic name with pronounciation and meaning 7147 views Q. 1817 views Q. Brother Asalam Alaikum In a Islamic Name Book I saw a name Ribah , companion of our Prophet. I was inspired with this name and put the name Riba Enterprises to my new form company. I registered the firm and completed all government formalities. Now I come to know that the meaning of this word is interest which is looking very unislamic . I am upset very much . Although in my mind ( niyat ) it was Islamic . At this stage I am not in a position to change the name . Brother let me know what is the effect of name , it context , what should be answer if some one ask about the name, in respect to keep my niyat in mind.. Yours truly! 1676 views Q. can we name a muslim boy 'Abu sufian'? 2590 views Q. Baby boy name 2705 views Q. Yusuf or Mohammad Yusuf 3667 views Q. Name 1889 views Q. The names of his first two sons are 1). Faizan Muhammed & 2). Muhammed Farhaan. His third son name is Muhammed Subhan and his age is 2 years. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. Because it is not good to naming for a muslim child as Muhammed Subhan. We would like to know the answer for this uestion from your end. PLease try to give the reply as soon as possible. My daughter name is shazia saleem i want to know what is the meaning of name and this name is good or not my husband didn't ask anybody when he choose the name. plz send me replay soon. 2865 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 824 Country: Pakistan Title: I would like to know if we can name our son Mustafa? I am confused since his complete name will be Syed Muhammad Mustafa. Is it permissible? Question: Assalam-o-Alaikum I would like to know if we can name our son Mustafa? I am confused since his complete name will be Syed Muhammad Mustafa. Is it permissible? Jazakallah Answer ID: 824 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 231=235/D) Yes, it is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
